_comment: The theme's shop options (sgs_shop_* theme mods, theme/sgs-theme/inc/shop-*.php) and how the site build's shop step (lib/site-build-shop-options.mjs) decides each from the shop draft. `read` names the reader that decides it from the draft (the surface's skeleton inventory, proposal and filled tree, the draft's template and logic); a null `read` is an option the step never writes, reported with `why`. `evidence` says what in the draft decides it. Values come only from the draft, never from another site. The five boolean-toggle options are written by the catalogue step (lib/site-build-catalogue-toggle.mjs) and are not listed here.

options.evidence: the width below which the draft swaps its filter rail for a drawer: the rail node's ownAlternativeBelow.value, which Fill's width gate writes from the draft's own threshold (lib/fill-width-gate.mjs)
the words of the listing's count (the element the results-count piece replaced) with the number of products as %d
the count's one-product branch in the draft's logic (a choice on the list's length being 1 between two words)

the draft's sort options in order, each mapped to the WooCommerce or theme order its logic sorts by (none: menu_order; the price field upwards: price; downwards: price-desc; the saving, recommended price minus price, downwards: sgs_biggest_saving; the brand as text upwards: sgs_brand_az), with the draft's words
a draft sort option ordering by the saving (recommended price minus price) downwards
the saving order needs the recommended price, which the catalogue step stores in _sgs_rrp
a draft sort option ordering by the brand as text upwards
the listing's prices: a whole amount printed with no pence ("£139") is on; a whole amount printed with .00 is off
the filter drawer's apply button carries the listing's count ("Show {{ count }}")
the apply button's words, the count's own wording standing for the number ("Show %d frames")
the words of the other button beside the drawer's apply button
the drawer's apply and clear buttons both draw their words in capitals (text-transform: uppercase)
the rail draws no background and no border: plain; a background or a border: panel
at the widest width the rail's first words are its first group's label (no heading above the groups): off; words above the first group: on
the rail's width at the widest width, in px
the space between the rail's right edge and the listing's left edge at the widest width, in px
the draft's filter button's words carry a value of their own beside its label ("Filter {{ activeCountLabel }}"): on; plain words: off
at the phone width the draft's filter button shares one row with the count and the sort control: toolbar; its own row: row
the draft's filter button is fixed or sticky at the phone width: on; in the flow: off
the rail's on-off switch row (the catalogue's boolean facet) sits after every placed group: bottom; before them: top
the sort select's font size, in px

options.why: only a draft listing with a fixed column count decides it; the drafts' listings are an auto-fill grid or a per-width count the option cannot hold, and a value would force columns the draft does not draw
the listing's minimum card width is a value of the draft's grid template (minmax), read by Fill on the collection block, and the option holds one value with no phone value
the listing's gaps are read by Fill on the product collection; the option holds one desktop value
the listing's gaps are read by Fill on the product collection; the option holds one desktop value
the listing's phone gap is read by Fill on the product collection
rows or a grid at phone width: the step does not yet read the listing's phone columns
the space below the clone's own stuck header, which only the built site shows
a hovered swatch's growth is a hover look the step does not read
the select's arrow (the browser's own, the theme's, or one joined to a pill) is drawn by the draft's styles and image the step does not read
the theme's filled and outlined filter buttons hard-code their sizes, so no value draws another draft's button (a missing feature)
the theme's chosen-filter pills hard-code their sizes (a missing feature); the chosen filters show only once a filter is picked, which the inventory does not read
the chosen filters show only once a filter is picked, which the inventory does not read
the chosen filters show only once a filter is picked, which the inventory does not read
the theme's thin price slider hard-codes its track and handle (a missing feature)
the filter chips' text size is part of the chip look F-6 writes on the chips block
